<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_ServiceForYourFridge"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_FacilityArrival" name="Facility arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairNotCompleted" name="Fridge not repaired"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Confirmation that fridge is OK"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rating" name="Service facility rating"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForYourFridge">

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Customer_WaitForRepairOutcome" name="Wait for repair outcome"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Central_Flow_1" sourceRef="Central_RequestReceived" targetRef="Central_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Central_Flow_2" sourceRef="Central_SelectFacility" targetRef="Central_SendAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Central_Flow_3" sourceRef="Central_SendAssignment" targetRef="Central_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Local service facility process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Facility_AssignmentReceived" name="Facility assignment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Facility_AssignmentMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_FacilityAssignment"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Facility_MakeAppointment" name="Make an appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Facility_Arrival" name="Arrive at a random time">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Facility_ArrivalMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_FacilityArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Facility_PartsDecision" name="Are additional parts needed?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Facility_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Facility_RepairNotCompleted" name="Repair not completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Facility_RepairNotCompletedMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_RepairNotCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Facility_EndWithoutRepair" name="Visit ends without repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Facility_RepairFridge" name="Repair the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Facility_RepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Facility_RepairCompletedMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Facility_EndRepaired" name="Repair completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_1" sourceRef="Facility_AssignmentReceived" targetRef="Facility_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_2" sourceRef="Facility_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Facility_Arrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_3" sourceRef="Facility_Arrival" targetRef="Facility_PartsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_PartsNeeded" name="Additional parts are needed" sourceRef="Facility_PartsDecision" targetRef="Facility_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_PartsNotNeeded" name="Additional parts are not needed" sourceRef="Facility_PartsDecision" targetRef="Facility_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_6" sourceRef="Facility_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Facility_RepairNotCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_7" sourceRef="Facility_RepairNotCompleted" targetRef="Facility_EndWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_8" sourceRef="Facility_RepairFridge" targetRef="Facility_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Facility_Flow_9" sourceRef="Facility_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Facility_EndRepaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>

rules.instruction: When the description says that information or a decision is requested from other participants and that the process waits for their responses before continuing: Model the wait after the request as an intermediate message catch event in the sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description says that the process waits for an external participant to arrive at an unspecified time

rules.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules.situation: the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process.

rules.instruction: When the description presents process activities in a stated order: Model the corresponding flow nodes in that order with sequence flows, connecting the start event to the initial activity and the final activity to the end event.
rules.situation: the description states an order or transition among process steps, events, decisions, or outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
